card.name: Separators between numbers in tables and readings
card.fires_on: The space, comma or slash that sits between two numbers, just before the next number. Seen in lists of volumes (50 mL 100 mL 250 mL), blood pressure readings (90/50) and numeric ranges.

modes.label: Gap in volume lists
modes.description: A space or comma between successive mL amounts in dosing tables, right before the next amount.

modes.label: Slash in blood pressure
modes.description: The slash between systolic and diastolic values.
